reviews.review:
Pros:
- Incredibly extensive mission editor
- Realistic tactical maneuvers achievable even with AI team-members
- Vehicles and Weaponry + Attachments in wide variety and quite realistic
- Active and documented modding community
- ZEUS mode = live mission editor, zeus player creates scenarios WHILE other players are playing
- New Addons are usable in the game, but restricted by Game-Logo obscured views, it is possible to test every part of a not owned addon in the editor, cars, weapons, etc. Gear has to be put on beforehand and can't be picked up ingame.


===
Cons:
- Like every Arma game -> Needs high performance machine to run smoothly because all models are over the top high poly and because gamelogics are ineffieciently and unconventionally built

- Sometimes hackers in Online Games, Anti-Cheat solution useless when needed.
- Online Games tend to have very low FPS compared to Singeplayer Game in same location with bots, no lag, but lower FPS. Poor optimization.

- Because of overblown models and code, game updates can be 10GB - 25GB <- HUGE turnoff factor to me personally.
- Arma Games still have no physics. Vehicle Collision is clumsy and hitting "destructible" things triggers a "falling over" animation. Killed soldiers become ragdolls for a short period after death, then are frozen.

- You cannot jump as a soldier. I personally find this offensive in an "infantry combat simulation". Perhaps it has to do with the "no physics" feature to prevent bugs related to freerunning/parcour.



===
Overall, I can't say the game has any factor that makes me NOT recommend buying it.
It's a ton of fun playing coop missions with friends, or even making my own missions.

It is however, not a quick action arcade shooting game and by extension not everyone's cup of tea.

Basically it's like Garry's Mod (extensive, creative knowledge based gameplay) compared to Counter Strike Source (Quick Action Arcade Shooter).

I Recommend This Game To All I've played over 600hrs on Arma 3 and can say its the best thing I've ever purchased so many dlcs you can get for the game the devs always working on something new, So many types of servers on arma like roleplay servers, king of the hill and much more. On A roleplay server you will start with o most nothing a hobo, in other words, have to do legal/illegal jobs to climb up and avoiding the police/rebels there may be times where you get ziptied by some guy flown to a hill and made to sing or they kill you but I can see RP servers on arma are my favorite.

Before buying make sure your pc can run Arma as it does require a bit of punch, i personally use an AMD fx 9590 and i have no issues what so ever.​​​​​​​

The bullet penetration is quite realistic. You have to buy this game.
I recommend you to use this shooting range to learn how to handle your weapon and improve your aim. 
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1181989097
Very realistic and gameplay seriously enhanced when using mods. Definitely worth it.
